title: mail: axum HTTP server with /health
description:
Wire an axum Router in crates/mail/src/server.rs: bind TcpListener to config.listen.addr, add GET /health endpoint returning {status:ok, uptime_secs}. Add graceful shutdown via tokio::select! on CTRL-C and SIGTERM (same pattern as transit main). Call from main().

Why: having a working HTTP server with one endpoint validates the stack before JMAP-specific routes are added.

Acceptance: curl http://127.0.0.1:<port>/health returns JSON 200 in a test.
